  • Everything School Tech has handed you about AI so far flows one direction, company to you. This is the one that flows back.
  • Your assistant currently drafts in a generic School Tech register, because nothing in the system knows how you write.
  • What you enter here becomes your personal writing profile. It is used only for your drafts, never anyone else's.

  • When you are done, click Generate .md at the bottom and send the downloaded file to Adam.

Voice samples
This section carries the form
  • This is the highest-value section here, and it is the one people skip.
  • Self-description does not work. On 2026-08-19 this exact problem was caught and fixed in the first profile built for this system.
  • The person had described his own work voice as "bare-bones and concise, as few words as possible, no flourish, not apologetic."
  • His actual sent mail from 2022 to 2026 opens "Hi Vlad, hope your year's off to a great start!" and closes "Much appreciated, Vlad!"
  • He was wrong about himself, and the assistant shipped colder drafts than he actually writes for months before anyone noticed.
  • Five real emails would have caught it on day one.
  • You can skip these rows and the form still completes. The profile you get is materially worse, and the assistant keeps drafting in a register that is not yours.
  • Redact before you paste. Swap real names for [Customer], [District], [Colleague], [Vendor]. Strip ID numbers, case numbers, phone numbers and addresses.
  • Leave the wording and the structure exactly as you sent it. The profile needs the shape of how you write, never the specifics of who you wrote about.
  • A redacted email is just as useful here. AI Restricted Data Reference Guide.docx is the authority on what has to come out.
